english:
Scoring 3 Combatant Kills with a Sword within 5 seconds of each generates 3 Ammo.

<exotic Praxic Blade /> and <exotic Ergo Sum /> receive 2 Ammo instead.

Has a 1 second cooldown between triggers.

source.text:
Upon scoring 3 Combatant Kills within 5 seconds of each with a Sword:

Generates +3 Ammo.
Praxic Blade and Ergo Sum receive +2 Ammo instead.

Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon triggering.
